Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 11100 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-04–2026-06), queried against Brent's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 2.8579 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (114% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 14.9498 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (123% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 295,752 (2021 resident population of 339,800, scaled by a density-based proxy resident-vs-workday ratio from the ONS's 2011 Census release for Brent — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.

Frequently asked questions

Is Brent safe?

Based on real, current UK Police data, Wandroz rates Brent as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night, relative to the other London boroughs currently on the automated pipeline. The rating comes from 11100 recorded incidents over 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06), split into a day-weighted score (property crime) and a night-weighted score (violence, robbery, antisocial behaviour).

Is Brent safe at night?

Brent's night score is roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz, based on the categories most relevant after dark (violence, robbery, street theft, public order, antisocial behaviour), normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population rather than plain residents where that data exists, so busy central boroughs aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents.

What official data is Brent's rating based on?

11100 recorded incidents from data.police.uk (the UK Police's official open crime API), queried against Brent's real administrative boundary and covering 3 months (2026-04 to 2026-06) — refreshed automatically every month, not a one-off snapshot. Full category breakdown is shown further down this page.
